versions.changelog:
Affiliate Partner Program Generator v1.0.0 initial release:

- Generates complete affiliate and partnership programs from scratch, including program structure, commissions, recruitment materials, marketing assets, and reporting frameworks.
- Offers 4 guided prompts: architecture & commissions, partner recruitment kit, partner marketing toolkit, and performance optimization/reporting.
- Designed for SaaS founders, e-commerce brands, course creators, agencies, and freelancers.
- Flexible pricing: one-time, monthly subscription, done-for-you, and agency tiers available.
- Provides all content needed to launch, recruit for, and optimize high-performing affiliate programs.
